applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Regional rural banks are permitted to alternatively obtain certified copies for Foreign Portfolio Investors from specified overseas authorities, but no new mandatory action is imposed.
answer.action_quote: it has been decided to extend the above facility in case of Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs).

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025
